entries.title: We've launched Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`)
entries.summary: 发布 Claude Sonnet 5.5，上线 Claude API、Bedrock、Google Cloud 与 Microsoft Foundry。

entries.title: We're resuming billing for refusals that arrive before any output when `stop_details.category` is `"bio"`, `"frontier_llm"`, or `"reasoning_extraction"`
entries.summary: 恢复对 bio、frontier_llm、reasoning_extraction 等类别前置拒答的计费；Compliance API 活动流不再返回文件名。

entries.title: Cache diagnostics is out of beta on the Claude API and no longer requires the `cache-diagnosis-2026-04-07` beta header
entries.summary: 缓存诊断正式退出 beta，无需 beta 头，Messages 响应始终含 diagnostics 字段。

entries.title: We've launched Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`), a model for long-running agentic coding and knowledge work
entries.summary: 发布 Claude Opus 5.5：1M 上下文、128k 输出、$4/$20 每百万 token，思考不可关闭。

entries.title: For cache diagnostics, a response to a request that sends the `cache-diagnosis-2026-04-07` beta header now always includes the `diagnostics` field
entries.summary: 缓存诊断响应始终返回 diagnostics 字段，未请求时为 null；Compliance API 增返 Chrome 会话记录。

entries.title: The Messages API can now compact a conversation on demand
entries.summary: Messages API 支持按需压缩对话（compact-2026-09-04 beta），并新增 thinking 前缀失配报告。

entries.title: Claude Managed Agents permission policies now include `auto`
entries.summary: Managed Agents 权限策略新增 auto，由服务端逐次评估每次工具调用；ant CLI 1.32.0 支持连接会话。

entries.title: For cache diagnostics, the API now stores a request's fingerprint only when the request includes the `diagnostics` object
entries.summary: 仅当请求含 diagnostics 对象时保存指纹，否则后续 previous_message_id 会报未找到。

entries.title: Version 1.30.0 of the `ant` CLI adds `ant apply`
entries.summary: ant CLI 1.30.0 新增 ant apply，以仓库文件声明式管理代理、环境与部署；每消息 effort 扩展到 Google Cloud。

entries.title: We've launched Claude Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1`) ... alongside Claude Mythos 5.1 (`claude-mythos-5-1`)
entries.summary: 发布 Fable 5.1 与 Mythos 5.1，1M 上下文，$10/$50，缓存读取降至 $0.25/百万 token。

entries.title: In Python SDK 1.2.0, TypeScript SDK 0.122.0, Go SDK 1.68.0, Java SDK 2.59.0, Ruby SDK 1.67.0, and C# SDK 12.44.0, `client.beta.files` and `client.beta.skills` no longer send the `files-api-2025-04-14` and `skills-2025-10-02` beta headers
entries.summary: 多语言 SDK 的 beta.files/skills 不再发 beta 头；控制台新增个人密钥与服务账号密钥。

entries.title: The Compliance API session endpoints are out of beta for Cowork and Claude Code sessions
entries.summary: Compliance API 会话接口正式发布并新增 Claude Science 与 M365 会话；Admin API 进入 ant CLI 与各 SDK。
